title: Re-initialize SQLAlchemy InstanceState on model_copy for table models
excerpt:
When calling `model_copy()` (or deprecated `copy()`) on a table model instance (especially one attached to or loaded from a database session), Pydantic's default `BaseModel.model_copy` performs a shallow copy of `__dict__`, copying `_sa_instance_state` by reference. ... This leads to subtle and severe bugs...
Solution: Overrode `SQLModel.model_copy(...)` to detect when `is_table_model_class(self.__class__)` is true. Stripped the copied `_sa_instance_state` from `new_copy.__dict__` and initialized a fresh SQLAlchemy `InstanceState`...

title: Add optional soft delete support with query filtering
excerpt:
The API I would like to discuss could include:

- `SoftDeleteMixin`, using `deleted_at` by default
- `SoftDeleteSession.delete()`, which marks soft-deletable models as deleted instead of physically deleting them
- default filtering for `SoftDeleteSession.exec(select(...))`, so soft-deleted rows are hidden by default
- an option such as `include_deleted=True` to include soft-deleted rows
- support for custom soft delete field names, for example with `__soft_delete_field__`
